description: Enhance existing Transaction entity and create new Transfer, AuditLog entities with repositories for fund transfer functionality
steps: Enhance Transaction.java in src/main/java/com/revana/bank/transaction/entity/ to add fields: transactionReference (String), sourceAccount (String), destinationAccount (String), transferType (enum), description (String), dailyLimitCheck (boolean). Add @PrePersist for transactionReference generation.

Create Transfer.java entity in src/main/java/com/revana/bank/transaction/entity/ with fields: id, transactionReference, sourceAccount, destinationAccount, amount, transferType (IMPS, NEFT, RTGS), description, status (PENDING, SUCCESS, FAILED, REVERSED), createdAt. Use Lombok annotations following existing pattern.

Create AuditLog.java entity in src/main/java/com/revana/bank/transaction/entity/ with fields: id, userId, sourceAccount, destinationAccount, amount, action, details, timestamp, status. Use Lombok annotations.

Create TransferRepository.java in src/main/java/com/revana/bank/transaction/repository/ extending JpaRepository<Transfer, Long> with methods: findByTransactionReference, findBySourceAccount, findByDestinationAccount, findByStatus, findByCreatedAtBetween.
Create AuditLogRepository.java in src/main/java/com/revana/bank/transaction/repository/ extending JpaRepository<AuditLog, Long>.
Create TransferStatus.java enum in src/main/java/com/revana/bank/transaction/entity/ with values: PENDING, SUCCESS, FAILED, REVERSED.
Create TransferType.java enum in src/main/java/com/revana/bank/transaction/entity/ with values: IMPS, NEFT, RTGS.
Update TransactionRepository.java to add findByTransactionReference method.
acceptance_criteria: mvn clean compile succeeds with no compilation errors
All entities compile with Lombok annotations correctly
Repository interfaces extend JpaRepository with correct generic types
Enums are properly defined with all required values
verification: Run mvn clean compile to verify code compiles
Run mvn test to ensure existing tests still pass
